By Lindemann-Weierstrass + Gelfond-Schneider, tau = 2*pi is transcendental and hence tau^q is transcendental for every nonzero rational q in Q \ {0}; we do NOT assume transcendence of tau^K for irrational algebraic K in A_R \ Q (an open Schanuel-type problem), whereas density of Q in A_R and R already suffices for the spectral/analytic continuation steps.

multiplicity_and_jordan_socle_audit.socle_theorem_statement: By Meyer (arXiv:math/0412277 Cor. 4.2 & Thm. 5.8), each nontrivial zero rho of xi(s) with multiplicity m_rho = ord_xi(rho) >= 1 contributes the finite-dimensional generalized eigenspace E_rho = ker((^t D_- - rho)^{m_rho}) of dimension m_rho >= 1. Even if m_rho > 1 and ^t D_- has a non-trivial nilpotent Jordan part N_rho on E_rho, the socle ker(^t D_- - rho) subset E_rho has dimension >= 1, and any nonzero socle vector l_{rho,0} in ker(^t D_- - rho) \ {0} is a strict eigenvector satisfying U_K l_{rho,0} = tau^{K(rho - 1/2)} l_{rho,0}. Thus Target 1 requires only a positive inner product on the socle (or a semisimple multiplicity-weighted eigenspace) and never assumes simplicity of zeros.

scalar_correlation_vs_operator_jordan_sc.scalar_correlation_boundedness_equivalen: RH <==> sup_{K in A_R} |C_tau(K)| <= C_tau(0) <==> sup_{K in A_R} |C_tau(K)| < infty holds unconditionally in zero multiplicity m_rho >= 1 in BOTH directions: (i) Under RH (Re(rho) = 1/2), each distinct zero rho = 1/2 + i*gamma_rho of multiplicity m_rho = ord_xi(rho) >= 1 satisfies Res_{s=rho}(xi'(s)/xi(s)) = m_rho and Res_{s=rho}(-xi'(s)/xi(s)) = -m_rho, so in the explicit-formula contour shift across s = rho (clockwise orientation), -Res_{s=rho}(-F_tau(s) F_tau(1-s) (xi'(s)/xi(s)) tau^{-K(s-1/2)}) = +m_rho |F_tau(rho)|^2 tau^{-i K gamma_rho} (with no polynomial drift in K), giving |C_tau(K)| <= sum_{rho distinct} m_rho |F_tau(rho)|^2 = C_tau(0) < infty; (ii) Conversely, by the Fixed-Seed RH Equivalence Theorem (TASK-TC-037 / Theorem 12), sup_{K in A_R} |C_tau(K)| < infty implies RH via Laplace-Carleman analytic continuation without assuming zero simplicity.
scalar_correlation_vs_operator_jordan_sc.socle_operator_unitary_realization_equiv: Realizing the socle eigenvectors l_{rho,0} in ker(^t D_- - rho) \ {0} (or a semisimple multiplicity-weighted eigenspace) in a positive-definite inner-product space with V_K^* = V_{-K} is equivalent to Re(rho) = 1/2 for all zeros (RH alone, arbitrary m_rho >= 1).
scalar_correlation_vs_operator_jordan_sc.full_generalized_eigenspace_unitary_real: On the algebraic direct sum of finite-dimensional generalized eigenspaces (+)_rho E_rho, an abstract Hilbert-space unitary realization of {V_K}_{K in A_R} exists if and only if RH + Simplicity (Re(rho) = 1/2 and m_rho = 1 for all zeros), because for m_rho >= 2 the nilpotent Jordan chain V_K l_{rho,1} = tau^{K(rho-1/2)} (l_{rho,1} + (K log tau) l_{rho,0}) has norm growing linearly in |K|. On Meyer's full topological cotangent quotient H_-^0 = H_- / Z(H_+ cap H_-) (a nuclear Frechet space), any Hilbert-space unitary realization that faithfully embeds the generalized eigenspaces E_rho implies RH + Simplicity (a one-way necessary condition); conversely, an abstract diagonal Hilbert model on (+)_rho E_rho does not by itself establish a topology-compatible positive Hilbert inner product on the nuclear Frechet quotient H_-^0.
scalar_correlation_vs_operator_jordan_sc.algebraic_direct_sum_vs_meyer_topologica: On the algebraic direct sum of finite-dimensional generalized eigenspaces (+)_rho E_rho, an abstract Hilbert-space unitary realization of {V_K}_{K in A_R} exists if and only if RH + Simplicity (Re(rho) = 1/2 and m_rho = 1 for all zeros).
